bead.bead_why: the jamb reads as two flat planes - a beige return at tone 0.92 and a lit frame face at 1.11 - meeting in a hard step; no narrow highlight line at the arris at 5x zoom

threshold.threshold_why: no threshold profile fitted - under the leaf there is a 2 px black gap, then a raw grey screed strip, then wood-look floor tile

window.shape: tall rectangle, upper half, moulded surround

handle.w_w_note: w_w is the hardware footprint across the leaf - here the rose diameter

peephole.peephole_why: leaf is half glazed; swept the whole painted field at 6x and there is no lens, ring or drilled boss anywhere on it

hinges.hinges_why: handle sits at x 0.07 so the leaf is hinged on the right, in the 21 px far reveal; no knuckles project past the leaf edge

extras: fixed narrow second leaf to the left, matching, with its own slim glazed panel
black lattice muntins with two cast quatrefoil scroll motifs in the glazing
rendered plaster surround forming a shallow porch box around the opening
perforated leaf-pattern metal pergola overhead (top of frame)
raw screed strip in place of a threshold
notes: Leaf measured is the right-hand active leaf of an unequal pair (handle at x 0.07, hinged right). The left jamb reveal borders the fixed narrow leaf, not the measured leaf, but is recorded as far/near of the same opening. Geometric midpoint falls on glass so colour was taken on paint at the same height (510,906); that spot sits in the head shadow, and the well-lit lower panel reads #C7C7C1 - the paint is a near-neutral white, the warm cast is the light. Unusually the leaf gets brighter toward the floor (profile 0.76 -> 1.00) because a deep porch soffit shades the head.
